nodes.name: Claude Code Settings
nodes.description: CLI hooks configuration with PostToolUse events for Chrome refresh automation

nodes.name: Giveaway Launch Protocol
nodes.description: Complete end-to-end process for launching giveaways: technical setup, content creation, publishing, and verification

nodes.name: POST /api/lead-magnet
nodes.description: Generic lead magnet capture route. Validates email, rates limits, saves to Supabase, sends via Resend, tracks events to Insight.

nodes.name: sendViaResend
nodes.description: Sends templated delivery emails based on giveaway source (speak-human, guardog, maccleaner, cult-brand-playbook, web-design-arsenal, etc.)
nodes.signature: async (email: string, source: string, idempotencyKey: string) => Promise<void>

nodes.name: GIVEAWAY_SOURCE_MAP
nodes.description: Maps giveaway page slugs to CRM source keys. Keys: maccleaner, guardog, cult-brand-playbook, web-design-arsenal, speak-human, claude-md, anthropic-safety-checklist, benchmark, all-sorted-overview.

nodes.name: ingestIntoCrm
nodes.description: Posts lead capture to Mission Control CRM with source and campaign tags (non-blocking)

nodes.name: POST /api/lead-magnets/claudemd
nodes.description: Specialized lead magnet route for Claude.md file delivery. Collects firstName + email, attaches CLAUDE.md file to email.

nodes.name: sendViaResend
nodes.description: Sends Claude.md file via Resend with personalized greeting and context about Masterminds HQ.
nodes.signature: async (firstName: string, email: string, idempotencyKey: string) => Promise<any>

nodes.name: FILE_CONTENT
nodes.description: Embedded CLAUDE.md template content (embedded at build time, 100+ lines of configuration template)

nodes.name: POST /api/lead-magnets/passive-income-100
nodes.description: Pre-launch list capture for '100 Ways to Make Passive Income with AI Agents'. Test mode by default, requires PASSIVE_INCOME_100_LIVE=1 for live sends.

nodes.name: LIVE_MODE
nodes.description: Feature flag controlled by PASSIVE_INCOME_100_LIVE env var. Defaults to test mode (sends to newyork1@gmail.com).

nodes.name: POST /api/subscribe
nodes.description: Main subscription handler using dependency injection pattern. Validates input, saves leads, claims signups, sends emails, handles suppressions.

nodes.name: SubscribeDeps
nodes.description: Dependency injection interface for subscribe route. Methods: saveLead, claimSignup, sendEmail, isSuppressed.
nodes.definition: { saveLead: (lead) => Promise<void>, claimSignup: (email, magnet) => Promise<boolean>, sendEmail: (...) => Promise<void>, isSuppressed: (email) => Promise<boolean> }

nodes.name: POST,GET /api/unsubscribe
nodes.description: RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe handler. POST from mail clients (automatic), GET from human clicks (renders confirmation page).

nodes.name: htmlPage
nodes.description: Renders dark-themed HTML response page for unsubscribe confirmation.
nodes.signature: (title: string, message: string, status?: number) => Response

nodes.name: recordUnsubscribeFromToken
nodes.description: Verifies token and records suppression to email-suppressions table.
nodes.signature: async (token: string | null) => Promise<{ok: true, email: string} | {ok: false}>

nodes.name: GUIDE_HTML
nodes.description: Embedded HTML content for Illy onboarding guide. Auto-generated from MHQ design. 1800+ lines of styled content with table of contents, sections, and interactive elements.

nodes.name: SessionGuideBrainPage
nodes.description: Server component for Session 4 workshop guide page. Renders guide content, breadcrumbs, footer navigation. Routes only slug='4'.

nodes.name: Session4Guide
nodes.description: Client component. Full Session 4 workshop guide: creating second brain, giving Claude personality, running brain dump, loading context. Includes video player, step cards, code blocks, checklists.

nodes.name: Checkbox
nodes.description: Interactive checkbox for review checklist. Changes appearance on click, triggers celebrate() animation when checked.

nodes.name: Session7Guide
nodes.description: Client component. Full Session 7 workshop guide: installing Mission Control task board, understanding workflow columns, creating first card, AI automation preview.

nodes.name: abandoned-checkout-followups
nodes.description: Email automation library for abandoned checkout recovery. Defines 2 automation paths (day-1 + t12h), builds emails, tracks state, evaluates candidates.

nodes.name: CheckoutFollowupAutomationKey
nodes.description: Union type: 'abandoned_checkout_day_1' | 'abandoned_checkout_t12h'

nodes.name: AbandonedCheckoutMode
nodes.description: Union type: 'off' | 'test' | 'live'. Controls whether automation runs and which recipients receive emails.

nodes.name: AbandonedCheckoutCandidate
nodes.description: Email candidate record: event, attendee email/name, checkout session ID, event URL, finance line inclusion flag.

nodes.name: CHECKOUT_FOLLOWUP_DEFINITIONS
nodes.description: Configuration map for two automated follow-up paths. Day 1: 24h after abandoned checkout. T12h: 12h before event with open spots requirement.

nodes.name: buildAbandonedCheckoutEmailHtml
nodes.description: Generates day-1 follow-up email HTML with personal greeting, checkout error acknowledgment, payment options, and CTA to event page.

nodes.name: buildAbandonedCheckoutT12hEmailHtml
nodes.description: Generates t12h follow-up email HTML (12h before event). Shorter, urgency-focused message with spot availability mention.

nodes.name: shouldIncludeFinanceLine
nodes.description: Determines if email should include financial support paragraph. False if donation mode or price <= $50.

nodes.name: UTM Parameter Tests
nodes.description: 13 tests for withUtm utility. Validates owned domain tagging, external domain pass-through, idempotency, token guard, fragment preservation.

nodes.name: UTM owned domain tests
nodes.description: Validates UTM tagging for workshop.mastermindshq.business, mastermindshq.business, joe-che.com

nodes.name: UTM external domain pass-through
nodes.description: Ensures external URLs (github, instagram, linkedin, youtube) return unchanged

nodes.name: UTM idempotency
nodes.description: Validates double-tagging is idempotent and second call overwrites params

nodes.name: UTM token guard
nodes.description: Ensures URLs with token= parameter (auth/unsubscribe/cancel) return unchanged
